origin.usage: close_state(x, warn = getOption("fansi.warn", TRUE), normalize = getOption("fansi.normalize", FALSE))

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Character vector, often the result of state_at_end.

arguments.name: normalize
arguments.text: Emit the specific closes. FALSE emits ESC[0m when any SGR is active.

origin.details: Emits only the closes for styles active at the end of each string. It does not carry state from one element to the next. With normalize false, any active SGR closes as ESC[0m.
origin.value: A character vector, or a data frame for unhandled_ctl.
